question: Rajesh, Heera, Neetu, Santosh, Pooja and Arti are sitting around a circle, facing the centre Rajesh sits second to the left of Arti. Arti sits third to the right of Pooja. Neetu sits second to the left of Santosh. Who sits to the immediate right of Santosh?
solution:
Given:

 
• Rajesh, Heera, Neetu, Santosh, Pooja and Arti are sitting around a circle, facing the centre .
 
• Rajesh sits second to the left of Arti.
 
• Arti sits third to the right of Pooja.
 
• Neetu sits second to the left of Santosh.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80e4787d6653d8ede6d591d13676973a4d6c8f33c6ab157ed93949eced3c3920.png] 

Heera Sit is immediately to the right of Santosh.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
